verdict.rationale: Drata documents a Policy Center and policy API endpoints for creating policies and for listing and creating policy versions. That evidences first-party policy management with versioning. The rest of the story is unevidenced: the Policy Center item is only a title, and the Personnel endpoints do not mention policy acceptance. Missing for 10: a lawyer-grade policy template library, an in-app policy editor, an approval workflow, per-employee acceptance tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
